producer_report.summary:
I revised docs/design/decision-sets.md and docs/design/defaults-loop.md to apply all eight section-6 changes of review 1, settling F1–F4 first. The review file is untouched. docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md also changed, as the deliverables list required. I ran no cargo checks, since only docs changed.

F1–F4:
- **F1:** The reader gets sets only through code-side class and phase narrowing, capped at K lines, with K starting at 0 because the reader set has 2 tokens of headroom (the measured 1,798 of 1,800 comes from the review). A new runtime per-job set-size check is a build item with its own test. The per-job "User defaults that apply" section gets a cap, `brief_set_tokens`. The designs state that defaults do not count against producer or verifier budgets today. "Refused by code" is now "a test, not a job-time check" in decision-sets §3 and defaults-loop §2 R2.
- **F2:** Assumptions and signals of a default go in a separate typed record keyed by default id, `athena.default-expectations/1`. `athena.defaults-proposal/1` gains `assumptions` and `signals`. Adding keys to `defaults.toml` is recorded as the alternative not chosen.
- **F3:** A host-error record, `athena.host-error/1`, is written by the client with `status_code`, `operation`, `job` and `phase`. Landing and host errors become watcher and introspection triggers (defaults-loop §3.1). The rejections sentence now cites `OutcomeState::Rejected`.
- **F4:** One evidence rule: a single event puts a decision under review, and N=3 distinct jobs governs adding a default. The "repeats" sentence in decision-sets §5 matches it. The D87 example's enforcement is now `brief`, with the reason stated. Its `landing` class is replaced by `*` plus the landing phase.

Remaining items:
- **F5/J2–J5:** The designs now say which matching parts are shared (client, request shapes, stored fields, model naming) and which differ. Set membership is one `boolean` per decision. Boolean thresholds read the probability of the `true` option. The stored-field list in defaults-loop §5 now covers host-error and check records, with no stderr from any job. The "request summary" is the `Reading.summary` field. A multi-question call must be probed before the client is written; I made no gateway call.
- **J6:** defaults-loop §10 adds labeled sets, scoring (Brier skill, miss rate, a critical failure for a dropped requirement) and separate promotion criteria for set membership and signal match.
- **F6/F7/F8:** The class vocabulary is closed to the `defaults.toml` values. `decisions_matched` is added to `athena.introspection/1`. A no-recursion rule says a firing's introspection is not watched, and observed interventions for host errors and check failures do not count toward N. The under-review state lives in an append-only `athena.decision-state/1` record, recorded as a versioned, hashed brief component.
- **F9:** Corrected the D89/changelog wording, the "12 entries" migration claim, the D01–D90 vs D91 count, the §7 item 8 citation of the log header, and the 1,500-token estimate (withdrawn, `render()` is unmeasured). Both status lines are updated.
- **D90:** I added a dated note on D90 in docs/decisions.md for its stale "section 9" reference instead of rewriting the entry. D91 gets a "Revised" note. CHANGELOG.md has a new "Changed" entry.

checks_run.note: Only CHANGELOG.md, docs/decisions.md and the two design docs are modified; the review file and crates/, defaults.toml and records/ are absent.

I did not run cargo fmt, clippy or test.

docs/decisions.md D46 and D87 already carry notes added after acceptance, so a dated note on D90 follows precedent.
The task requested edits to docs/decisions.md (deliverable) even though the log is accepted; I only appended notes.

A way to run a docs link or section-reference check to confirm cross-references like defaults-loop §3.1 and §8.1 still resolve.
